titles.title: Saintess: Conceive in the Name of God

description:
"Since the saintess desires it so much, I shall impregnate her at once." 

The saintess of the Dubur Empire, a land called sacred, committed the grave sin of daring to commit adultery and fleeing. In response, Dernaus, the empire's sole deity, proclaimed in anger: "Impregnate the lewd saintess." 

Agnes, with her brilliant silver hair, has a leper for a husband and a blind old woman for a mother-in-law. Every time the conditions of the saintess in the divine revelation pointed to her, she had to prove at every moment that she was not the saintess. And Raon, the man commanded by the sole deity's revelation to impregnate her. Agnes struggled desperately to escape him, but perhaps softened by comfort, before she knew it, she found herself longing for his touch and warmth. A woman called a lewd saintess, and a man who dedicated everything to God. The two who should never grow close gradually harbor forbidden desires for one another... 

"Before conception, I must cleanse you of your sins, Agnes." 

At the end of this twisted desire, does salvation await, or ruin?
